contextOnlyReferences.text: **D1 (math home: new crate vs geometry module).** Disagree with the recommendation. Clash's vector/AABB/triangle math is Plato-generated from `tools/plato/clash_math.plato` as the single definition, byte-compatible with `packages/clash` (`rust/clash/src/generated/mod.rs`), and the crate is zero-dependency on purpose (`rust/clash/Cargo.toml` has an empty `[dependencies]`; `rust/geometry/Cargo.toml:141`). What clash would take from a shared crate is a constant (`2^-22`, EDGE-CLASH-8) and a 14-line `canonical`/box-normal helper (EDGE-CLASH-4, XCUT-19). That does not justify a published crate with the MF3 costs. Every other consumer of v3/mat4/Aabb3/frame (processing, export, wasm, server, landxml) already depends on geometry (XCUT-4's own fix says so). Recommendation: `ifc_lite_geometry::math::{v3, mat4, aabb, frame, tol}` now, each module under 400 lines. For the clash seam: geometry already dev-depends on clash (GEOM-33, `test.yml:1795`); either promote that to a normal dependency so `clash_contact_axes` consumes clash's Plato types, or keep the 14-line clone under a parity test. Core (`model_bounds.rs`, XCUT-8) stays out of scope for the math home; its `ModelBounds` is six fields. Revisit a crate only if a consumer that cannot depend on geometry appears.

contextOnlyReferences.text: **D1 (math home: new crate vs geometry module).** Disagree with the recommendation. Clash's vector/AABB/triangle math is Plato-generated from `tools/plato/clash_math.plato` as the single definition, byte-compatible with `packages/clash` (`rust/clash/src/generated/mod.rs`), and the crate is zero-dependency on purpose (`rust/clash/Cargo.toml` has an empty `[dependencies]`; `rust/geometry/Cargo.toml:141`). What clash would take from a shared crate is a constant (`2^-22`, EDGE-CLASH-8) and a 14-line `canonical`/box-normal helper (EDGE-CLASH-4, XCUT-19). That does not justify a published crate with the MF3 costs. Every other consumer of v3/mat4/Aabb3/frame (processing, export, wasm, server, landxml) already depends on geometry (XCUT-4's own fix says so). Recommendation: `ifc_lite_geometry::math::{v3, mat4, aabb, frame, tol}` now, each module under 400 lines. For the clash seam: geometry already dev-depends on clash (GEOM-33, `test.yml:1795`); either promote that to a normal dependency so `clash_contact_axes` consumes clash's Plato types, or keep the 14-line clone under a parity test. Core (`model_bounds.rs`, XCUT-8) stays out of scope for the math home; its `ModelBounds` is six fields. Revisit a crate only if a consumer that cannot depend on geometry appears.

contextOnlyReferences.text: **D1 (math home: new crate vs geometry module).** Disagree with the recommendation. Clash's vector/AABB/triangle math is Plato-generated from `tools/plato/clash_math.plato` as the single definition, byte-compatible with `packages/clash` (`rust/clash/src/generated/mod.rs`), and the crate is zero-dependency on purpose (`rust/clash/Cargo.toml` has an empty `[dependencies]`; `rust/geometry/Cargo.toml:141`). What clash would take from a shared crate is a constant (`2^-22`, EDGE-CLASH-8) and a 14-line `canonical`/box-normal helper (EDGE-CLASH-4, XCUT-19). That does not justify a published crate with the MF3 costs. Every other consumer of v3/mat4/Aabb3/frame (processing, export, wasm, server, landxml) already depends on geometry (XCUT-4's own fix says so). Recommendation: `ifc_lite_geometry::math::{v3, mat4, aabb, frame, tol}` now, each module under 400 lines. For the clash seam: geometry already dev-depends on clash (GEOM-33, `test.yml:1795`); either promote that to a normal dependency so `clash_contact_axes` consumes clash's Plato types, or keep the 14-line clone under a parity test. Core (`model_bounds.rs`, XCUT-8) stays out of scope for the math home; its `ModelBounds` is six fields. Revisit a crate only if a consumer that cannot depend on geometry appears.
